text: 🍿 VisionQuest finally gives Vision a bounty and a bad day 📆 Release: October 14, 2026 🎭 Genre: #SciFi · #Fantasy · #Action ✈️ Add to watchlist /Film flags that Paladin, a deep-cut comic mercenary played by Todd Stashwick , is hunting a bounty on Vision. Me compra. A hired gun with no cape and no cosmic baggage is the right scale after 'WandaVision' . Paul Bettany has carried this character through every mood Marvel could throw at him. Ojo to Terry Matalas at the helm, who knows how to land a messy legacy. I just hope Paladin gets more than one fight scene to matter 🤞

🍿 Jackson Lamb meets Dobby, and it works This season, Gary Oldman (Sirius Black in 'Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban' ) shares scenes with Lenny Rush , the 17-year-old cast as Dobby in the HBO 'Harry Potter' . Lamb ends up shielding a kid whose father was murdered. Cute coincidence, sure. 🧙 What I like is that nobody sells it as a stunt. Rush plays a frightened boy opposite the foulest spy in London, and that's a better pitch than any wand-waving. 'Slow Horses' keeps landing sharp casting without begging for attention. 🕵️ ✈️ Add to watchlist

🍿 'Digger' is messy, and Cruise is why it works 📆 Release: October 2, 2026 🎭 Genre: #Comedy · #Satire ✈️ Add to watchlist Alejandro G. Iñárritu returns to English-language filmmaking for the first time since 'The Revenant' , with a "comedy of catastrophic proportions." SlashFilm's early review says his indulgences nearly sink it. That tracks. The 'Birdman' ego-trip energy is right there in the pitch. 🎬 What intrigues me is Tom Cruise as the lifeline. Since 'Tropic Thunder' we know he's game for gleeful self-parody, and an auteur with a big satirical swing needs exactly that anchor. I'm in, with one eyebrow raised.
